meta.title: Do not provide suggestions to convert to async when the callback is a generator
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#44147 (fix(44123): forbid convert to async for generator callbacks), 1f4c8708c2, 2021-05-28; git tag --contains: first in v4.4-beta / v4.4.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@4.3.5 (2021-06-30) and typescript@4.4.2 (2021-08-26), both behind typescript-language-server@0.7.1, started with the pinned tsserver.js (--tsserver-path); the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session. Deviation from the wrapper rule: the release current at 4.4.2 (0.6.1) starts but never reports the TypeScript version it runs (no 'Using Typescript version' log), so the build check cannot pass; 0.7.1 (2021-11-10) is the earliest wrapper that reports it and is the wrapper of the 4.4.4 -> 4.5.2 pilot case.
meta.notes: The fix stops offering the convert-to-async suggestion for a generator callback, so a post-fix build that offers no such action is 'absent' (missing: absent).

settings_note: The issue names no settings (playground defaults); no tsconfig.json, so tsserver uses an inferred project.

repro.steps: Open index.ts: the suggestion 'This may be converted to an async function' (TS80006) is shown for uppercaseAll, whose then-callback is a generator. Apply the quick fix 'Convert to async function'. Reported: the resulting code no longer compiles; expected: no such suggestion. Probe: after the fix, a fresh session on the edited file must neither report the targeted suggestion nor a new error. No offered action counts as absent.
